model_choice_reason: Canonical state, security, process authority and crash recovery integration
requirements: Implement report.md finite contract with actual production callers, typed request identity, current authentication before replay and before native activation, original input hash from bound host capability proof

Every intent revision witness in same transaction; explicit expected revision/state CAS and RowsAffected=1; cancel dominates and complete transaction rollback on partial successor/carry/fence failures
Fact/upload/seal/use durable before exactly-once ordered SealCheckpoint ACK; turn.paused plus native stop/drain/finalize/effects proof required; no false queue_empty or reportRun terminal conversion

Same Run successor epoch once, no original prompt replay, SDK_ACCEPTED/ENQUEUED/CONSUMED monotonic mapping and old journal epoch binding; expired confirmed pause never auto-runs; unknown native launch never blind retries
No public schema/enum/migration/backup dependency/SDK/bridge/Host setup/default assets changes. Escalate exact required source extension to Root with evidence rather than silently widen

Use new temporary schema25 product data only. Never access original DB/GUI/CDP/model provider. Native synthetic end-to-end has real Host/product session/task APIs/coordinator/AppContainer and accepted M1 worker; clearly separate synthetic provider from LIVE
All source/test receipts in unique formal mirror after freeze, full failure ledger preserved; author does not accept own work; no parent/formal acceptance derived
Do not compile new Go cache/temp on constrained C: use dedicated D workspace GOCACHE/GOTMPDIR or approved existing cache; no new full worktree copies, no deletes of old evidence
Exact16 extension permits only prepareEffectTx/beginEffectTx pause admission/drain fences in durability.go; no generic ResumeCheckpoint rewrite

New effect keys cannot be admitted during pause even through internal PrepareEffect. Idempotent query of existing key does not authorize redispatch. Only already durable PREPARED cut-before effect at exact current epoch/activeRun with PAUSE_REQUESTED may start while Task BLOCKED; preserve Goal/lease/budget/context/cancel gates

Tests must cover legal cut-before PREPARED once, ordinary BLOCKED, stale epoch, newkey/no extra reservation, cancel races, expired lease, STARTED/UNKNOWN replay denial. No old schema or unrelated flow acceptance weakening

Explicit Root policy extension: candidate narrow sealed-pause activation proof class; not general native resume qualification and not a string-only bypass of supports_resume. Implement all mandatory gates in referenced independent report.md

First prepare oldepoch requires installedschema25, nonlegacy/nonbootstrap full common admission, exact current PAUSED_CONFIRMED/CAS/RESUMEkey/hash/currentOwner/device/grants/Goal/Task/Run/context/input/dependencies, validated exact old HOST_PAUSE_CAPABILITY receipt/protocol/ACK/process/generation/input, exact sealed bytes/use/principal/journal and true STOPPED/drain/cleanup/effect/queue proof; cancel/restore fence wins

Successor epoch launch/recovery requires immutable activation and every old/new binding. Missing schema/activation/intent/receipt never falls through optional gate or ordinary claim. No repeated carry/epoch increment. PREPARED unstarted-only recovery; STARTED/UNKNOWN never blind rerun

Preserve ordinary resume refusal when supports_resume=false/resume_evidence_ref=null and every common admission. No fabricated qualification or historical receipt mutation. Host ACK alone is not independent native resume proof; independent implementation and actual Host/AppContainer E2E acceptance still required
